title: Grammar and Sentence Structure — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The list of winners (A) were announced (B) by the principal (C) at the end of (D) the ceremony."
items.reteach: Subjek utamanya "The list" (tunggal) → was announced.

items.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about the class trip.

visual.text: Each of the students has paid for the trip.

choices.say: Each of the students has paid for the trip.

visual.text: Each of the students have paid for the trip.

choices.say: Each of the students have paid for the trip.

visual.text: Each of student has paid for the trip.

choices.say: Each of student has paid for the trip.

visual.text: Each the students has paid for the trip.

choices.say: Each the students has paid for the trip.

items.reteach: Pola: Each of the + noun jamak + verb tunggal.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "I need (A) an information (B) about the (C) bus schedule to (D) Malang."
items.reteach: Information uncountable: some information, bukan "an information".

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "She (A) is (B) the most smartest (C) student in (D) her class."
items.reteach: Superlative cukup satu: the smartest (tanpa "most").

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "You (A) haven't finished (B) your project, (C) haven't (D) you?"
items.reteach: Kalimat negatif → tag positif: …, have you?

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "There (A) are (B) less (C) students in the library (D) today."
items.reteach: Untuk countable jamak dipakai "fewer", bukan "less".

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct word order.

visual.text: Can you tell me what time the museum opens?

choices.say: Can you tell me what time the museum opens?

visual.text: Can you tell me what time does the museum open?

choices.say: Can you tell me what time does the museum open?

visual.text: Can you tell me what time opens the museum?

choices.say: Can you tell me what time opens the museum?

visual.text: Can you tell me the museum what time opens?

choices.say: Can you tell me the museum what time opens?

items.reteach: Pertanyaan tak langsung memakai urutan pernyataan: subject + verb.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "Rina and (A) me (B) went to the (C) traditional market (D) yesterday."
items.reteach: Sebagai subjek dipakai subject pronoun: Rina and I.

items.prompt: Choose the option that is a sentence fragment and needs to be fixed.

visual.text: While we were waiting for the ferry to Madura.

choices.say: While we were waiting for the ferry to Madura.

visual.text: We waited for the ferry to Madura.

choices.say: We waited for the ferry to Madura.

visual.text: The ferry to Madura was late.

choices.say: The ferry to Madura was late.

visual.text: While we were waiting, the ferry arrived.

choices.say: While we were waiting, the ferry arrived.

items.reteach: Anak kalimat dengan "while" tanpa klausa utama adalah fragment.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "(A) The sun (B) rises in (C) the east and (D) set in the west."
items.reteach: Subjek tunggal "the sun" → sets (sejajar dengan "rises").

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct order of adjectives.

visual.text: She wore a lovely long blue dress.

choices.say: She wore a lovely long blue dress.

visual.text: She wore a blue long lovely dress.

choices.say: She wore a blue long lovely dress.

visual.text: She wore a long lovely blue dress.

choices.say: She wore a long lovely blue dress.

visual.text: She wore a lovely blue long dress.

choices.say: She wore a lovely blue long dress.

items.reteach: Urutan adjective: opinion – size – colour (lovely long blue).

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "My father (A) usually (B) drinks (C) black coffee every morning, (D) isn't he?"
items.reteach: Kalimat simple present dengan "drinks" → tag: doesn't he?

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "This is (A) the (B) more interesting (C) book (D) I have ever read."
items.reteach: "The … I have ever read" memerlukan superlative: the most interesting.

items.prompt: In the text about Kawah Ijen, the word "They" refers to …

stimulus.text: Every year, many tourists visit Kawah Ijen. They come to see the blue fire, which appears only at night. A guide is necessary because the path is steep and slippery.

items.reteach: "They come to see the blue fire" — yang datang adalah para turis.

items.prompt: According to the text about Kawah Ijen, why is a guide necessary?

stimulus.text: Every year, many tourists visit Kawah Ijen. They come to see the blue fire, which appears only at night. A guide is necessary because the path is steep and slippery.

visual.text: The path is steep and slippery.

choices.say: The path is steep and slippery.

visual.text: The blue fire is dangerous to touch.

choices.say: The blue fire is dangerous to touch.

visual.text: The crater is closed at night.

choices.say: The crater is closed at night.

items.reteach: Klausa "because the path is steep and slippery" memberi alasannya.

items.prompt: Which part of the Kawah Ijen text is a dependent clause giving a reason?

stimulus.text: Every year, many tourists visit Kawah Ijen. They come to see the blue fire, which appears only at night. A guide is necessary because the path is steep and slippery.

visual.text: because the path is steep and slippery

choices.say: because the path is steep and slippery

items.reteach: "Because" memulai klausa alasan.

items.prompt: According to the library notice, how many books can three visitors borrow altogether?

stimulus.text: ATTENTION: Each visitor is allowed to borrow two books. Neither magazines nor dictionaries may be taken home. Please return the books within a week.

items.reteach: Setiap pengunjung dua buku: 3 × 2 = 6.

items.prompt: Based on the library notice, which statement is true?

stimulus.text: ATTENTION: Each visitor is allowed to borrow two books. Neither magazines nor dictionaries may be taken home. Please return the books within a week.

visual.text: Dictionaries must stay in the library.

choices.say: Dictionaries must stay in the library.

visual.text: Magazines can be borrowed for a week.

choices.say: Magazines can be borrowed for a week.

visual.text: Each visitor can take five books.

choices.say: Each visitor can take five books.

visual.text: Books can be kept for a month.

choices.say: Books can be kept for a month.

items.reteach: "Neither magazines nor dictionaries may be taken home" = keduanya tidak boleh dibawa pulang.

items.prompt: In the library notice, why is the verb "is" used after "Each visitor"?

stimulus.text: ATTENTION: Each visitor is allowed to borrow two books. Neither magazines nor dictionaries may be taken home. Please return the books within a week.

visual.text: Because "each" is followed by a singular verb.

choices.say: Because "each" is followed by a singular verb.

visual.text: Because the notice is in the past.

choices.say: Because the notice is in the past.

items.reteach: Each + noun tunggal + verb tunggal.

items.prompt: According to the table of three cities, which sentence is correct?

visual.text: Batu is the coolest of the three cities.

choices.say: Batu is the coolest of the three cities.

visual.text: Malang is the coolest of the three cities.

choices.say: Malang is the coolest of the three cities.

items.reteach: Batu 22°C, suhu rata-rata terendah.

items.prompt: Based on the table, complete: "Malang is ___ than Batu but cooler than Surabaya."
items.reteach: Malang 24°C > Batu 22°C → warmer than Batu.

items.prompt: Which sentence about population in the table is correct?

visual.text: Batu has fewer people than Malang.

choices.say: Batu has fewer people than Malang.

visual.text: Batu has less people than Malang.

choices.say: Batu has less people than Malang.

visual.text: Malang has more people than Surabaya.

choices.say: Malang has more people than Surabaya.

items.reteach: People countable → fewer; Batu 0.2 juta < Malang 0.9 juta.

items.prompt: What type of sentence is the first sentence of the text about Raka and the robot club?

stimulus.text: Raka wanted to join the robot club, but he was shy. His friend, the club leader, encouraged him. Now Raka teaches the younger members himself.

items.reteach: Dua klausa independen dihubungkan "but".

items.prompt: In the text about the robot club, the word "himself" refers to …

stimulus.text: Raka wanted to join the robot club, but he was shy. His friend, the club leader, encouraged him. Now Raka teaches the younger members himself.

items.reteach: "Raka teaches … himself" — himself menegaskan subjek Raka.

items.prompt: What can we infer from the text about the robot club?

stimulus.text: Raka wanted to join the robot club, but he was shy. His friend, the club leader, encouraged him. Now Raka teaches the younger members himself.

visual.text: The club leader is younger than Raka.

choices.say: The club leader is younger than Raka.

items.reteach: Dulu pemalu, sekarang mengajar anggota baru → lebih percaya diri.

items.prompt: A: "Nobody called me while I was out, ___?" B: "Actually, Sinta did."
items.reteach: Nobody bermakna negatif dan memakai "they" pada tag → did they?

items.prompt: A: "How ___ money do we need for the tickets to Batu?" B: "About two hundred thousand rupiah."
items.reteach: Money uncountable → how much.

items.prompt: A: "Which bag is yours?" B: "The blue one is ___. The black one belongs to my sister."
items.reteach: Possessive pronoun tanpa noun: mine.

items.prompt: A: "Is the Suramadu Bridge longer than the bridge in your town?" B: "Yes, it's ___ longer."
items.reteach: Penguat comparative: much/far longer, bukan "very longer".

items.prompt: A: "Let's take a short break, ___?" B: "Good idea. I'm tired."
items.reteach: Tag untuk "Let's …" adalah "shall we?".

items.prompt: A: "Excuse me, do you know ___?" B: "Yes, it's next to the post office."
items.reteach: Pertanyaan tak langsung: question word + subject + verb.

items.prompt: Seller at Pasar Larangan: "Sorry, we don't have ___ durians today." Buyer: "Oh, maybe tomorrow."
items.reteach: Dalam kalimat negatif dipakai "any".

items.prompt: A: "Who cleaned the classroom after the party?" B: "Dimas and Ayu cleaned it by ___."
items.reteach: By themselves = sendiri tanpa bantuan.

items.prompt: Teacher: "Raka, what is the main idea?" Raka: "Sorry, I didn't hear the question. Could you repeat ___, please?"
items.reteach: "It" menggantikan "the question" (tunggal) sebagai objek.

items.prompt: A: "I don't like spicy food." B: "___ I. Let's order the mild soto."
items.reteach: Setuju dengan kalimat negatif: Neither do I.

items.prompt: A: "She hardly ever misses class, ___?" B: "No, she is very diligent."
items.reteach: "Hardly ever" bermakna negatif → tag positif: does she?

items.prompt: A: "Which is ___, the train or the bus to Banyuwangi?" B: "The train. It doesn't stop in every town."
items.reteach: Membandingkan dua hal → comparative: faster.

items.prompt: A: "There ___ a lot of traffic in Surabaya this morning." B: "Yes, I was late for school."
items.reteach: Traffic uncountable dan peristiwanya lampau → there was.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "never / late / is / school / she / for"

visual.text: She is never late for school.

choices.say: She is never late for school.

visual.text: She is late never for school.

choices.say: She is late never for school.

visual.text: Never she is late for school.

choices.say: Never she is late for school.

visual.text: She is never for school late.

choices.say: She is never for school late.

items.reteach: Adverb of frequency diletakkan setelah "be": is never late.

items.prompt: Combine into a compound sentence: "The bus broke down." + "We walked to the village."

visual.text: The bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

choices.say: The bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

visual.text: The bus broke down, but we walked to the village.

choices.say: The bus broke down, but we walked to the village.

visual.text: The bus broke down, or we walked to the village.

choices.say: The bus broke down, or we walked to the village.

visual.text: Although the bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

choices.say: Although the bus broke down, so we walked to the village.

items.reteach: Hubungan sebab–akibat memakai "so".

items.prompt: Combine into a complex sentence: "It was raining." + "The match continued."

visual.text: Although it was raining, the match continued.

choices.say: Although it was raining, the match continued.

visual.text: Because it was raining, the match continued.

choices.say: Because it was raining, the match continued.

visual.text: Although it was raining, but the match continued.

choices.say: Although it was raining, but the match continued.

visual.text: It was raining although, the match continued.

choices.say: It was raining although, the match continued.

items.reteach: "Although" untuk pertentangan; jangan dipakai bersama "but".

items.prompt: Change into a yes/no question: "She has finished her homework."

visual.text: Does she has finished her homework?

choices.say: Does she has finished her homework?

items.reteach: Pindahkan auxiliary "has" ke depan subjek.

items.prompt: Rewrite "What time does the ferry leave?" starting with "Do you know …"

visual.text: Do you know what time the ferry leaves?

choices.say: Do you know what time the ferry leaves?

visual.text: Do you know what time does the ferry leave?

choices.say: Do you know what time does the ferry leave?

visual.text: Do you know what time the ferry leave?

choices.say: Do you know what time the ferry leave?

visual.text: Do you know the ferry what time leaves?

choices.say: Do you know the ferry what time leaves?

items.reteach: Pertanyaan tak langsung: tanpa "does", verb mengikuti subjek (leaves).

items.prompt: Turn "Your mother works at the hospital" into a tag question.

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't she?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't she?

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, isn't she?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, isn't she?

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't he?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, doesn't he?

visual.text: Your mother works at the hospital, don't she?

choices.say: Your mother works at the hospital, don't she?

items.reteach: Simple present "works" → doesn't; mother → she.

items.prompt: Fix the fragment: "Because the road to Bromo was foggy."

visual.text: We drove slowly because the road to Bromo was foggy.

choices.say: We drove slowly because the road to Bromo was foggy.

visual.text: Because the road to Bromo was foggy and slowly.

choices.say: Because the road to Bromo was foggy and slowly.

visual.text: Because the road to Bromo was very foggy.

choices.say: Because the road to Bromo was very foggy.

visual.text: Because foggy the road to Bromo was.

choices.say: Because foggy the road to Bromo was.

items.reteach: Tambahkan klausa utama agar kalimat lengkap.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "most / of / the / students / passed / the / test"

visual.text: Most of the students passed the test.

choices.say: Most of the students passed the test.

visual.text: The most of students passed the test.

choices.say: The most of students passed the test.

visual.text: Most the of students passed the test.

choices.say: Most the of students passed the test.

visual.text: Of the most students passed the test.

choices.say: Of the most students passed the test.

items.reteach: Pola quantifier: most of the + noun jamak.

items.prompt: Rewrite using "as … as": "Ayu is 155 cm tall. Rina is also 155 cm tall."

visual.text: Ayu is as tall as Rina.

choices.say: Ayu is as tall as Rina.

visual.text: Ayu is as taller as Rina.

choices.say: Ayu is as taller as Rina.

visual.text: Ayu is as tall than Rina.

choices.say: Ayu is as tall than Rina.

items.reteach: Sama tinggi: as + adjective dasar + as.

items.prompt: Rewrite with "not as … as" and keep the meaning: "Malang is cooler than Surabaya."

visual.text: Surabaya is not as cool as Malang.

choices.say: Surabaya is not as cool as Malang.

visual.text: Malang is not as cool as Surabaya.

choices.say: Malang is not as cool as Surabaya.

visual.text: Surabaya is not as cooler as Malang.

choices.say: Surabaya is not as cooler as Malang.

visual.text: Surabaya is not so cool than Malang.

choices.say: Surabaya is not so cool than Malang.

items.reteach: A cooler than B = B not as cool as A.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct noun phrase: "a / small / wooden / old / box"
items.reteach: Urutan adjective: size – age – material.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "There are some mangoes in the basket."

visual.text: There aren't any mangoes in the basket.

choices.say: There aren't any mangoes in the basket.

visual.text: There aren't some mangoes in the basket.

choices.say: There aren't some mangoes in the basket.

visual.text: There isn't any mangoes in the basket.

choices.say: There isn't any mangoes in the basket.

visual.text: There aren't no mangoes in the basket.

choices.say: There aren't no mangoes in the basket.

items.reteach: Negatif: some → any; mangoes jamak → aren't.

items.prompt: Rewrite "All the players received a medal" starting with "Each".

visual.text: Each of player received a medal.

choices.say: Each of player received a medal.

visual.text: Each the players received a medal.

choices.say: Each the players received a medal.

items.reteach: Each + noun tunggal (each player).

items.prompt: Riddle: I come before "hour" and "honest" but never before "university". What am I?
items.reteach: "An" dipakai sebelum bunyi vokal; university berbunyi /ju/ → a university.

items.prompt: Which word is the odd one out? furniture, luggage, equipment, suitcase
items.reteach: Suitcase countable; tiga lainnya uncountable.

items.prompt: Which sentence is the odd one out because its question tag is not correct?
items.reteach: "Likes" → doesn't he? "I am …" memakai tag khusus "aren't I?".

items.prompt: Code: S = subject, V = verb, O = object, T = time. What is the pattern of "Yesterday my sister baked a cake"?
items.reteach: Yesterday (T) – my sister (S) – baked (V) – a cake (O).

items.prompt: Logic: Sinta is not as tall as Rina. Rina is not as tall as Ayu. Who is the tallest?
items.reteach: Sinta < Rina < Ayu, jadi Ayu paling tinggi.

items.prompt: Analogy: I : mine = we : ___
items.reteach: Subject pronoun → possessive pronoun: I → mine, we → ours.

items.prompt: Analogy: good – better – best = bad – ___
items.reteach: Bentuk tidak beraturan: bad – worse – worst.

items.prompt: How many complete sentences are there? (1) Ran to the gate. (2) Stop! (3) The bell rang. (4) After the bell rang.
items.reteach: "Stop!" adalah kalimat perintah lengkap (subjek "you" tersirat) dan "The bell rang." lengkap.

items.prompt: Which word fits BOTH blanks? "___ of the two answers is correct." / "I like ___ tea nor coffee."
items.reteach: Neither of the two …; neither … nor ….

items.prompt: Riddle: I turn a statement into a short question at its end. After "Let's …", I am always "shall we". What am I?
items.reteach: Question tag: pertanyaan pendek di akhir kalimat.

items.prompt: Which is the odd one out by structure? "in the park" / "under the table" / "after school" / "when it rained"
items.reteach: "When it rained" adalah clause (ada subjek + verb); lainnya phrase.

items.prompt: Which word fits BOTH blanks? "___ people came to the show." / "___ chairs were empty."
items.reteach: People dan chairs countable jamak → many.

items.prompt: Letter puzzle: In the correct sentence "Everyone ___ here," the missing word has two letters. What is it?
items.reteach: Everyone tunggal → is.

items.prompt: Arrange "goes / my brother / by bus / to school" into a correct sentence. Which phrase comes LAST?
items.reteach: My brother goes to school by bus.
